prompt: The Sikh empire's capital at the time of the Battle of Sobraon came under the rule of the British Crown in what year?
answer: The Sikh Empire’s capital, **Lahore, came under British rule in 1849**, when the British East India Company annexed the Punjab. (Direct rule by the British Crown began later, in **1858**.)
